description: Concordant-type fold (north star: reduce types). ReusableConsCapture is defined byte-for-byte TWICE: body::ReusableConsCapture (src/compiler2/body.rs:148-151, { head: ValueId, source: ValueId }) and artifact::ReusableConsCapture (src/compiler2/artifact.rs:559-562, identical). The nominal mismatch forces a pointless field-copy conversion at jobs/backend.rs:723-727 (map |capture| artifact::ReusableConsCapture { head: capture.head, source: capture.source }) and an import alias at jobs/native.rs:31 (ReusableConsCapture as BackendReusableConsCapture). FIX: keep body::ReusableConsCapture (earliest pipeline stage), delete artifact's copy and re-export/import body's; delete the backend.rs copy-conversion (use the value directly) and the native.rs alias. Concordance check: identical fields + semantics (a cons-cell reuse capture: which head value reused from which source), no invariant added at the Backend stage (unlike sibling capture_positions: Vec<TransportPosition>, which IS genuinely new at Backend and correctly stays). ~12 non-test refs (body/artifact/pull/jobs/{body,native,backend}). SAFE, mechanical. Directly serves fz-go4's 'remove unnecessary cloning/copying/conversions'. Two-lane audit (correctness + confirm no invariant lost).

Net -12 lines.
